patch.objective: Planning and managing risk: identifying and analyzing risks, maintaining a risk register, and executing a risk management plan

sources.cite: PMI, Project Management Professional (PMP) Examination Content Outline, July 2026 Update: People 33%, Process 41%, Business Environment 26%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a copy of PMI's PDF hosted by a training provider (the course seed cites PMI's own copy). Relevant text: Domain II Task 8 'Plan and manage schedule' ('Baseline a project schedule'; 'Execute a schedule management plan'; 'Analyze schedule variation'); Domain III Task 3 'Manage and control changes' ('Execute the change control process'; 'Communicate the status of proposed changes'; 'Implement approved changes to the project'); Task 4 'Remove impediments and manage issues' ('Recognize when a risk becomes an issue'); Task 5 'Plan and manage risk' ('Maintain a risk register'; 'Execute a risk management plan'). The objective wording here is the course seed's. Business Environment Task 5 'Plan and manage risk' ('Maintain a risk register'; 'Execute a risk management plan') is the objective this band registers.

The food distributor, the project, the probabilities, impacts, costs and support gauges are fictional teaching figures for exam practice, not measured values. Expected monetary value is probability times impact: 0.4 x 500 = 200 thousand dollars before the response, 0.1 x 500 = 50 after it.
